key_updates: XRPLWin reports 6.02M USDC and 712.52M RLUSD on XRPL, making RLUSD supply approximately 118.36 times the reported USDC supply on the same indexer.
The largest RLUSD/XRP AMM pool displays 2.34M RLUSD and 1.87M XRP, with 35,388 trades over 30 days; the largest USDC/XRP pool displays 130.29K USDC and 104.3K XRP, with 33,522 trades over 30 days.
The RLUSD/USDC pool exists on XRPL with 25.08K RLUSD and 26.17K USDC, 24 LP holders and 144 30-day trades. This is permissionless pool evidence, not a formal Circle-Ripple partnership.
XRPL USDC is approximately 0.0086% of Circle's $70B global USDC circulation as of October 29.
Circle reports $70B USDC circulation and $71.4B reserves as of October 29, with $3.1B net redemptions over 30 days. This is issuer-level supply contraction, not XRP inflow.
Circle's Q2 2026 10-Q reports reserve income at 95.2% of total revenue, a 3.5% reserve return rate, and $324.6M Q2 / $655.3M H1 distribution costs to Coinbase.

Coinbase's Q3 2026 10-Q reports 59% lower consumer spot volume and 53% lower institutional spot volume year over year, while average USDC on platform reached an all-time high and derivatives, DEX and borrow/lend activity grew.
Coinbase Q3 net income of $718.7M included $715.0M of gains on crypto assets held for investment, primarily BTC and ETH; operating income was $61.7M.
Coinbase's Q3 stablecoin revenue was $306.9M, down 5% year over year, while nine-month stablecoin revenue was $904.5M, approximately flat year over year.
